headline: Foreign Residential Property Purchases in Turkey Reach 2026 Monthly High
summary: Residential real estate sales to foreign buyers in Turkey reached their highest monthly level of 2026 in October, according to official data from the Turkish Statistical Institute.
why: Foreign home acquisitions generate foreign direct investment and capital inflow into Turkey's housing sector.
